State_change_caption: Observing the sequence of these frames, one can trace the dynamic process of chili sprinkling. Initially, the chili pieces are densely gathered in the center, showing the starting point of the sprinkling. As the person shakes their hand, the chilis begin to disperse outward, creating a more balanced coverage over the pizza. By the final frame, the action has concluded, and there is a noticeable difference in the spread of the chilis, indicating a deliberate and careful distribution. This progression not only demonstrates the methodical application of toppings but also the ephemeral nature of the task, with the final distribution serving as a static testament to the motion that preceded it.
